Class NoteManager

java.lang.Object
gamemode.gym.note.NoteManager
public class NoteManager extends Object
Manages the lifecycle of all active Notes in the gym rhythm mini-game.

Responsibilities include spawning new notes onto the scene, moving all notes downward each frame, removing notes that fall off screen (applying a miss penalty), and checking whether a player key press successfully hits a note in a given lane.

  • Method Details

    • spawnNote

      public void spawnNote(int lane, javafx.scene.image.Image img, int noteSize, int startX)
      Spawns a new note in the given lane and adds it to the scene. The note starts just above the top of the screen.
      Parameters:
      lane - the lane index to spawn the note in (0 = left, 1 = right)
      img - the image to display for the note
      noteSize - the width and height of the note in pixels
      startX - the base X offset from which lane positions are calculated

    • updateNotes

      public int updateNotes(double speed)
      Moves all active notes downward by the given speed and removes any that have fallen below the screen.

      Each note that goes off screen contributes a penalty of 30 points to the returned total, representing a missed note.

      Parameters:
      speed - the number of pixels to move each note downward this frame
      Returns:
      the total miss penalty accumulated from all off-screen notes this frame

    • checkHit

      public boolean checkHit(int lane, double judgmentY)
      Checks whether a hittable note exists in the given lane and removes it if so.

      Only the first matching note found is consumed per call. A note is considered hittable if it is in the specified lane and its bottom edge is within 70 pixels of judgmentY.

      Parameters:
      lane - the lane index to check (0 = left, 1 = right)
      judgmentY - the Y coordinate of the judgment line
      Returns:
      true if a hittable note was found and removed; false otherwise
